required_outputs: exact old committed heads for each failed trial
original solver status, message, nfev, residuals and candidate heads
alternative diagnostic solver status and residuals
best achieved cell and global mass residual
committed state unchanged during all diagnostic trials

decision_rule.qualification_solver_blocker: an independent diagnostic solver finds an in-bounds root with cell/global residual <=1e-12 while the original solver reproduces failure
decision_rule.residual_or_physics_blocker: no diagnostic solver finds an in-bounds root within the hard 1e-9 mass certificate
decision_rule.mixed: only some frozen failed trials admit an independently resolved root

hard_guards: Do not relax the 1e-9 mass acceptance gate.
Do not modify E3 physics, forcing, timestep, face formulas or committed state.
Alternative solvers are qualification diagnostics only and are not production candidates in this gate.
No E3 requalification follows directly from this diagnostic.
No runtime, tangent or MultiSWAP qualification.
